mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, lesson_id as lessonId, is_completed as isCompleted, complete_time as completeTime FROM learning_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, user_id as userId, lesson_id as lessonId, is_completed as isCompleted, complete_time as completeTime FROM learning_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND lesson_id = #{lessonId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_progress (user_id, lesson_id, is_completed, complete_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{lessonId}, #{isCompleted}, #{completeTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_progress SET is_completed = #{isCompleted}, complete_time = #{completeTime} WHERE id = #{id}
